data.name: Bhaumik
data.gender_notes: Bhaumik is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who is related to Bhauma, the earth god. In Hindu mythology, Bhauma is the deity who is the lord of the earth and is responsible for its protection and sustenance. The name Bhaumik carries the meaning “Earth God” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Bhaumik usually hope their child will grow to embody earth god and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Connection to the earth and its divine energies.
data.etymology: Bhaumik belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Earth God.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Bhaumik total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

This name pays homage to Bhauma, the earth god, and reminds us of our connection to the earth and our responsibilities towards its preservation.
